request_summary.last_message: {"content":"Organisation: initech-003. Admin role: it_admin.\n\nRequest: How many of our Macs are on a macOS version below 15?","role":"user"}

content.text: {"intent":"question","restated_question":"Count the devices in initech-003 running macOS whose latest snapshot reports a major OS version below 15 (i.e. macOS 14 Sonoma or earlier), and list them.","assumptions":["'Macs' means devices whose OS is macOS, based on the latest telemetry snapshot.","'Below 15' means major version less than 15; any 15.x counts as not below.","Devices with no OS version reported are excluded and noted separately."],"steps":[{"tool":"query_devices","purpose":"Filter devices on their latest snapshot to OS = macOS with major version < 15, returning the count and the device list."}],"may_propose_actions":false,"out_of_scope_reason":""}
